use: Copy-stage records only. Preserve facts and supplied uncertainty. Do not borrow experiment values from these training pages. Layout-stage need not read this file.

proseTokens.structure: Configurations standalone role; two ordinary bullets; Observation standalone role; two ordinary bullets. First observation wraps one line at same text x.

families.workingCadence: Short scientific experiment-type title; standalone plain configuration/observation roles; direct condition bullet then one scoped result and one exception-bound comparison. A long result may wrap; keep the relationship rather than rewriting into slogan plus caption.
doNotAdd: Bold role headings absent from this family
A polished abstract or claim banner
doNotCopy: Experiment names, values, thresholds or condition labels from the training slide
Accidental grammar damage as an authorship trick

proseTokens.structure: Bold standalone Summary then three ordinary Step items; first two have two hollow sub-bullets each. Second sub-bullet in each wraps at nested x. Pending Step3 is plain body text.

families.workingCadence: Standalone bold Summary role; three ordered plain Step items, with preprocessing details and attention/FFN parameter-scope exceptions nested below their parent. Final pending stage stays an ordinary summary item. Figure remains a second operational account, not a replacement for the report.
doNotAdd: Uniform bold prefixes for every step
Red warning/banner for a pending stage that is already explicit
Definitions of familiar project parameter notation
Visible maker instructions or process caveats
doNotCopy: Method names, improvement magnitude or exact operation list from the training slide
Accidental punctuation or grammar damage as an authorship trick
